asterion04.title: The Gate
asterion04.tlstill.man: She is afraid too. I can hear her heart from here.
asterion04.tlback.man: She stepped back. They all step back.
asterion04.dl1: You... you're the one knocking on the stone.
asterion04.dhook: The College is coming down. Now, tonight. With dogs. Because of you. Because of me.
asterion04.dl3a: They're coming for me too. I saw the College take Domícia. Now there's no one left to lie for me.
asterion04.dl3b: The dogs... they're following my fire. I'm the one who brought them here.
asterion04.dkey: I stole my father's key. The one to the Gate of the closed eye. Down there, they'll never find you.
asterion04.erun.hint: To the portal of the closed eye, on the right. The dogs are behind. (F: sniff the way)
asterion04.dlgate: The chamber of the three portals. The closed eye, the waves, the smooth stone. Mirto's key goes into the eye... and won't turn. The bronze doesn't know a man's hand.
asterion04.dlflamestrong: Lívia's flame leans toward the lock, and the stone shows what it was hiding: a second keyhole, in the center of the eye. The key turns.
asterion04.dlflameweak: Lívia's flame trembles, weak, like something never used for this. It takes time. The dogs are already on the stairs.
asterion04.mlhold.hint: The dogs are close. Wait for her flame. Breathe.
asterion04.mlhold.held: Waited for her flame without losing control.
asterion04.mlhold.strained: Waited for her flame by a thread.
asterion04.mlhold.lost: Lost control while waiting for her flame.
asterion04.dopen: The bronze gives way. On the other side, the dark of the deep labyrinth breathes.
asterion04.clfinal: She is on this side of the Gate. He is on the other.
asterion04.clfinal.close: Close the Gate between them. "Go back."
asterion04.dlgoes2: One day I'll go back. Not today.
asterion04.dlgoesn: She passes through the Gate. The bronze closes behind them both, and the flame in the cup lights a dark where no fire of Vesta has ever been.
asterion04.dlarrested: The Gate closes. Outside, Lívia is left alone with the flame, facing the dogs. She doesn't run. When the Hunters arrive, she is already on her knees, the cup raised.
asterion04.dlreturns: Someone has to keep the flame alight.
asterion04.dlreturnslie: I'll say you went too deep for anyone to follow. It isn't a lie.
asterion04.dlreturnsn: She leads Mirto by the hand, up the stairs. No one touches a Vestal's ward. The Gate closes.
asterion04.tnfled.man: ...who was it? Temple fire came down the stairs tonight.
asterion04.dn2a: They're already on the stairs! I heard the dogs coming down!
asterion04.dn2b: There's still time, if we run.
asterion04.enrun.hint: To the portal of the closed eye, on the right. The dogs are behind. (F: sniff the way)
asterion04.dngate: The chamber of the three portals. The closed eye in the bronze. Mirto's key turns, sticks, turns. The Gate opens onto the deep.
asterion04.dnquinto: The Hunters arrive. In front, a familiar torch: Quinto, limping. He sees Mirto. Hesitates. And points down the wrong gallery: "That way! I heard it that way!"
asterion04.cnfinal: The Gate is open. The dogs, close.
asterion04.cnfinal.send: Send Mirto back and close the Gate alone.
asterion04.dntake: My father will think I'm dead.
asterion04.dntake2: The two of them pass. The Gate closes behind them, and the barking of the dogs becomes an echo, farther and farther away.
asterion04.dnsendok: Mirto runs up the stairs. The Hunters pass him as if he were no one. Just a boy with a lamp.
asterion04.dnsenddies: Mirto runs up the stairs. A bark. A scream that stops halfway.
asterion04.mnfight.hint: The Hunters are coming. Frighten them, don't kill. Breathe.
asterion04.mnfight.held: Faced the Hunters without letting the beast out.
asterion04.mnfight.strained: Faced the Hunters holding the beast by a thread.
asterion04.mnfight.lost: The beast won, in front of Mirto.
asterion04.dnfightheld: He only frightens them. The dogs back away whimpering, the men back away with them. Mirto escapes. Wounded, Asterion goes through the Gate.
asterion04.dnfightlost: The beast wins. Shadows on the wall. A thread is cut, and it isn't his. Mirto saw it all. He lives, but he runs from Asterion the way everyone runs.
asterion04.dmwith: Mirto ducks under his arm, without asking.
asterion04.dmaloneok: Mirto runs up the stairs. The Hunters, busy with the Gate, barely notice a boy with a lamp.
asterion04.tendlivia.man: Fire, down here. For the first time, it doesn't burn.
asterion04.tendtwo.man: Two, down here. We were never two.
asterion04.tendalone.man: On the inside, a hand on the bronze. On the other side, far away, a knock.
asterion04.tnrecalla.man: He held out the bread and his hand didn't shake. He ran his finger over the closed eye, the way I do.
asterion04.tnrecallb.man: I growled at him. I turned my back. He came back anyway, with bread.
asterion04.dlocked: My father locked me in the house. He said a stranger told him to. A stranger! I climbed out the window. He'll know where I went.
asterion04.dnsendfather: Mirto runs up the stairs. At the top, holding a lantern, Nísio is waiting, as if someone had warned him. He pulls his son into the house and bars the door before the dogs reach the street.
asterion04.dnsendtaken: The Hunters catch Mirto on the stairs. He doesn't scream: he only holds the lamp with both hands. They take him alive, to the College, to ask about a closed eye scratched on a shard.
asterion04.dngateopen: The Gate stands open. No guard, no lock. As if the keeper had forgotten what a gate is for.
